gates.G0_sample: discovery cascade trades (A2 account) >= 20 and episodes (7-day gap) >= 8; else INCONCLUSIVE
gates.G1_net_edge: discovery mean net trade return (A2) > 0 and its episode-cluster bootstrap one-sided 95% lower bound > 0
gates.G2_timing: discovery mean net trade return (A2) > the 90th percentile of the random-entry placebo (same coins, same counts, same rules and costs, eligible signal hours of the discovery window)
gates.G3_mechanism: discovery mean GROSS return of cascade trades > that of control trades (control: drop-only hours - same price leg, OI change above its 5% tail - with no cascade hour on the same coin in the preceding 1 + entry lag + hold bars; trade-level, debounced; drop size not matched); NOT_EVALUABLE if fewer than 5 control trades
gates.G4_account: discovery A2 account: end equity > start, max drawdown >= -25%, realized P&L without the 3 largest winners > 0
gates.G5_stress: discovery accounts S1 (A2, entry 4h after the signal) and S2 (doubled slippage) both end above start
gates.G6_screen_2023: if the 2023 A2 account has >= 3 trades its mean net trade return must be >= 0; with fewer than 3 trades the screen is uninformative (flagged) and does not block
gates.verdict: PROMISING (a candidate for validation, never proof) only if G0-G6 all PASS; INCONCLUSIVE if G0 fails or G3 is NOT_EVALUABLE; otherwise FAIL
